rows.note: Use 競爭 as the all-purpose verb when people rival one another for the same position, prize, or outcome.

example.english: Both companies want to compete for this government contract.
example.traditional: 兩間公司都想競爭呢份政府合約。
example.jyutping: loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 soeng2 ging6 zang1 ni1 fan6 zing3 fu2 hap6 joek3

rows.note: Use 比賽 when someone takes part in or plays in a contest, game, or sporting event rather than simply vying for an outcome.

example.english: We compete in a soccer match against the neighboring class on Sunday.
example.traditional: 我哋星期日同隔籬班踢波比賽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 tung4 gaak3 lei4 baan1 tek3 bo1 bei2 coi3
